enrichment method: Enriched glycosomal fractions were loaded on a 10% acrylamide SDS-PAGE gel
fractionation method: Enriched glycosomal fractions were loaded on a 10% acrylamide SDS-PAGE gel
instrument: nanoLC-MS/MS analysis on a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer
precursor tolerance: Mass tolerances in MS and MS/MS were set to 10 ppm and 0.02 Da
fragment tolerance: Mass tolerances in MS and MS/MS were set to 10 ppm and 0.02 Da
ptm: oxidation of methionine (dynamic); acetylation of lysine (dynamic); deamidation of asparagine and glutamine (dynamic); Carbamidomethylation on cysteine (static)

The oxidation of methionine, acetylation of lysine, and deamidation of asparagine and glutamine were searched as dynamic modifications. Carbamidomethylation on cysteine was searched as a static modification.
